decisions.reason: As a care-related service with its own page, the evening psychiatric day-patient program likely meets at least minimum aspirations and would usually be retained while management learns more about demand.
The carpentry workshop is somewhat peripheral to residential care, but its dedicated page suggests enough organisational commitment and slack to keep it on the market for now.

Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's social-care mission, yet its lower website prominence suggests only moderate confidence, so it is kept but with a meaningful risk of review if results disappoint.
Being shown on the home page indicates the counseling service for senior living is strategically important and likely performing near or above aspiration levels, making withdrawal unlikely.

The retail shop appears more peripheral and only lightly presented, so if its results fall short of aspirations management is likely to reallocate resources to core care activities or other developments.
